rationale: M7 HPO campaign 2026-09-27 (manifest ../../campaign-2026-09-27.json), pre-committed before any result: ALL eight pre-registered ADR-007 §3 configs of this dataset (grid frozen in crates/ruvector-kge-bench/src/config.rs), HPO seed 100, <= 100 epochs, early stop on valid MRR (Bottom) after 5 evaluations without a strictly better value, valid evaluated every epoch.
